entities.summary: Hans Fróði á Toftanesi is a retired footballer who played as a centre-back. He made 26 appearances for the Faroe Islands national team. In 2018 he was sentenced to three years and nine months in prison for having instigated woman to commit 41 sexual assaults against her four-year-old son.
